audit.whatIsWrong: All seven sides disagree with their own whys. Sides read Jayce / Skill x5 / Jayce; the whys read even, Jayce, Jayce, Jayce, Volibear, Jayce, Volibear.
audit.why: That why sequence is exactly the packet chart, so the prose was written to the packet and the sides were never updated. 48.31% over 859 games fits a lane you lose to poke and win at 6 and at two items.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-6: Skill / Jayce / Jayce / Jayce / Volibear / Jayce / Volibear, ratings 5/3/3/3/7/3/7.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] credits Stormbringer with 'bonus HP, movement speed and shred'. It has no movement speed and no shred.
audit.why: Riot's text: Stormbringer leaps 550, slows and damages beneath him, grants bonus Health, and disables nearby enemy towers. The resistance shred in this matchup belongs to Jayce — his first attack after swapping to Mercury Cannon reduces your Armor and Magic Resist.
audit.corrected: A 550-range leap on 160s that grants bonus health and disables his tower.

audit.whatIsWrong: Shock Blast carries no cooldown anywhere on the page, and the Acceleration Gate interaction is only implied by the phrase 'Q-Gate'.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'If Shock Blast is fired through the gate the missile speed, range, and damage will increase.' Shock Blast runs 16/14/12/10/8/6s and the gate 20/18/16/14/12/10s — the poke gets twice as frequent across the lane.
audit.corrected: 16s at rank 1 down to 6s; through the gate it gains range, speed and damage.

audit.whatIsWrong: tldr and report[0] both say to dive 'when his form is down'.
audit.why: The weapon swap is a 6-second cooldown with no mana cost. There is no meaningful window where his form is unavailable — the window you want is Shock Blast's, and your own level 6.
audit.corrected: Dodge Shock Blast, then leap the gap at 6.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1] is titled 'Get E-knocked' with generic filler underneath.
audit.why: Thundering Blow is the Hammer E: magic damage plus a knockback at 240 range on 20/18/16/14/12/10s. It is what removes you from your own 300-range Q after you finally close.
audit.corrected: Thundering Blow knocks you out at 240 range, 20s at rank 1.

edits.before: Your R Stormbringer is the equalizer — the bonus HP, movement speed and shred let you close the ranged gap and burst him down once you land Q into E Sky Splitter slow.
edits.after: Stormbringer is the equalizer — a 550-range leap on 160s that grants bonus health and disables his tower, so you close the gap Shock Blast was holding.

edits.after: - Shock Blast: matchup-defining — 16s at rank 1 falling to 6s; fired through Acceleration Gate it gains range, speed and damage. - Thundering Blow: the Hammer knockback, 240 range, 20s at rank 1. - His weapon swap is only 6s.

notes: Adopted the packet chart because it matches all seven whys on this page word for word. The mirror (jayce__volibear) was set to Jayce / Jayce / Jayce / Skill / Volibear / Skill / Volibear, which differs on rows 0, 3 and 5 — flagged for the user. Jayce's Mercury Cannon transform reduces your Armor and MR on its first attack; that is worth adding to a spike if a future pass has room, but no field on this page had length budget for it.
